Not two monsters of this land are quite alike.

Archetypes: every monster has a nature - aggressive, a mage, a supporter that heals its kin, a coward that runs - and fights with real skills of that nature.

Hidden strengths: monsters may be born with passive skills, such as resistances or masteries. The more they have, the tougher they are, and a monster with many of them glows with an aura. Each one also gives more experience and better loot.

Every time a monster is born again, its strengths are rolled anew.
